فككت (form I)

# فَكَكْتِ (fakakti) /fa.kak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of فَكَّ (fakka)
# فُكِكْتُ (fukiktu) /fu.kik.tu/: first-person singular past passive of فَكَّ (fakka)
